justification: The ghost reconstructs the original with semantic fidelity. Core claims match: (1) the golden rule of self-similarity (whole-oriented good) has a structural vulnerability - the definer of 'whole' controls 'good'; (2) a co-equal second law forbids any node from adjudicating its own boundary alone; (3) this law prevents the first from becoming a license/permission slip; (4) this second law is ratified/settled, not provisional/open. Phrasing differs substantially ('companion law' → 'partner principle', 'seam' → 'flaw', 'checked from outside' → 'comes from beyond'), but the logical skeleton and all substantive relations transfer. The ghost's unpacking of 'whoever defines the whole' is a gloss that clarifies rather than invents. No semantic content from the original is dropped or inverted. The reconstruction is partial only in stylistic compression (fewer metaphors, more direct syntax), which is recoverable and does not obscure the standing law itself.
